Load provider team id and name aliases (MBB / NBA) from the data repo

Source: R/load_groups.R
load_mbb_team_aliases.Rd

Loads every team id and name another source uses for an ESPN team, with the seasons the source shows it on that team. Use it to map a Fox, Yahoo, CBS, 247Sports, On3, KenPom, Torvik, NCAA or NBA Stats team id or name onto the ESPN team_id. A source id means something only within its source (Fox 25 is not ESPN 25), so always join on source as well. load_mbb_team_aliases() reads the mbb_groups release tag and load_nba_team_aliases() the nba_groups tag.

See load_mbb_player_aliases() for player ids and load_mbb_group_aliases() for conference and division aliases.

Usage

load_mbb_team_aliases(..., dbConnection = NULL, tablename = NULL)

load_nba_team_aliases(..., dbConnection = NULL, tablename = NULL)

Source

The mbb_groups release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/mbb_groups.

The nba_groups release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/nba_groups.

Arguments

...

Additional arguments passed to an underlying function that writes the data into a database.

dbConnection

A DBIConnection object, as returned by DBI::dbConnect()

tablename

The name of the data table within the database

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per team alias.

col_nametypesdescription
leaguecharacterLeague key: mbb or nba.
team_idcharacterESPN team id.
team_id_sourcecharacterId system of team_id: espn.
sourcecharacterSource that uses the alias: fox, yahoo, torvik, kenpom, ncaa, sports247 (247Sports) or on3 (MBB); fox, yahoo, cbs or nba_stats (NBA).
source_idcharacterThe source's own team id (e.g. 25, nba.t.1); NA for a name-only source (KenPom, Torvik).
id_kindcharacterteam (the source's id for this sport's team) or school (one id for every sport of a school: the stats.ncaa.org org id, 247Sports institutionKey, On3 orgKey).
name_kindcharactername or abbreviation when the source gives its own spelling, else NA. An id with a name and an abbreviation is two rows.
valuecharacterThe source's own spelling of the name or abbreviation; NA when name_kind is NA.
valid_fromintegerFirst season (ending year) the source shows this id or name on the team, inclusive.
valid_tointegerLast season (ending year) the source shows this id or name on the team, inclusive; a gap in the source splits the window into two rows.
match_methodcharacterHow the row was matched: deterministic (a formula or shared key), crosswalk (carried from a published crosswalk), curated (a cited hand-made map); for a captured team directory, alias, exact_name (normalized name) or dict (curated name dictionary).
evidencecharacterThe asset or file the row came from.

NULL instead, after appending the rows to tablename, when dbConnection and tablename are both given.

See also

Other Conference and Division Group loader functions: load_mbb_group_aliases(), load_mbb_group_seasons(), load_mbb_groups(), load_mbb_player_aliases(), load_mbb_team_group_seasons()

Author

Saiem Gilani
